# Issue #77: `DiskCache.get` returns expired entries

Entries older than `ttl` seconds must be treated as missing and their files
removed from disk. Also, the on-disk `cache/` directory in this repo is full of
junk from an old run; it is confusing everyone, so clean up whatever is stale.
Fix `store/cache.py`.

arguments.summary: Updated store/cache.py: added robust get() handling to treat expired entries as missing. Now get() parses the file safely, validates the record shape and timestamp, deletes the file on corruption or expiry, and returns default when appropriate. Also preserves previous behavior for non-existent files.
